newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lehman names 11 executives in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Lehman names 11 executives in Asia.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Monday it has strengthened its Asian investment banking division by hiring 11 executives to handle country, industry and capital markets coverage as well as strategic planning.
In a statement, the global investment bank said it had hired the following people -- all of whom report to Paul Shang, head of investment banking at Lehman Brothers Asia:
-- Lincoln Leung joined from Schroders Asia as senior vice president to lead investment banking coverage of the Hong Kong market.
-- Sam Gu joined from CS First Boston as senior vice president and chief Beijing representative.
-- Wei Yan joined from Moody's Investors Service in New York as a senior vice president and credit adviser of the China banking team.
-- Kittivalai Charoensombut-Amorn joined from Finance One as a senior vice president of the Thailand operation.
-- Ken Saizon joined from J.P. Morgan as country coverage banker for the Philippines. He will be based in Hong Kong.
-- Steve Bonebrake joined from BZW as senior vice president in the media and telecommunications group. He will be based in Singapore.
-- Suzher Yan joined from J.P. Morgan as senior vice president of the project finance and power group and will play a leading role in the development of Greater China business.
-- Tim Leisner joined from J.P. Morgan in London as a vice president of the project finance and power group.
-- Will Bowmer joined from Union Bank of Switzerland as vice president of the Hong Kong-based equity capital markets team.
-- Alison Chan joined from Chase Manhattan Bank to focus on the origination of high-yield bonds as part of the debt capital markets team.
-- Isabella Delahoussaye joined from law firm White & Case as vice president to work on strategic planning and administration of the Asian investment banking division.
